item.title: Microsoft's Copilot chatbot is running into problems
Sam Altman responds to Anthropic's "Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude" ads
item.description:
📝 ) Anthropic serves an expensive product to rich people. Maybe even more importantly: Anthropic wants to control what people do with AI—they block companies they don't like from using their coding product (including us), they want to write the rules themselves for what people can and can't use AI for, and now they also want to tell other companies what their business models can be. This time belongs to the builders, not the people who want to control them.
🔗 Read more: https://xcancel.com/sama/status/2019139174339928189

item.title: Debian's Challenge When Its Developers Drift Away
item.description:
📝 The issue being encountered isn't that Debian's volunteers stop contributing but that it happens without communicating it to other Debian developers. Particularly for those delegated to different Debian teams and they stop being involved or Debian packages that gradually become unmaintained. Without other Debian developers being aware when one temporarily or permanently steps away from the project, they aren't able to effectively deal with the situation.
🔗 Read more: https://www.phoronix.com/news/Debian-Developers-Quiet-Away
